phases.objective: Prove the exact completion-certification metadata upgrade against the repository root OpenAPI document without mutating repository state.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the patched precise registry writer against a temporary copy of the actual repository root OpenAPI document, registry, and Support Ticket route source.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The completion-certification inline operation becomes the exact reviewed local path-item reference, check mode is idempotent, and the repository worktree remains unchanged.
steps: Copy the actual root OpenAPI document, precise registry, and Support Ticket route source to an isolated temporary directory.
Run the exact patched precise-contract writer with write mode.
Verify the completion-certification path is the reviewed local reference and no registry or route source changes occur.
Run check mode against the migrated temporary document.
Verify the original repository root document digest is unchanged.
assertions: The actual root completion-certification operation is eligible for the single allowlisted metadata-only upgrade.
The exact reviewed path-item reference is composed.
Write mode reports no conflict and check mode reports no drift.
Only the temporary OpenAPI document changes.
No repository mutation, provider dispatch, credential access, external send, or secret output occurs.
